prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: pixel-art voxel game terrain tileset atlas. Create exactly one square 1024x1024 PNG image with a precise edge-to-edge 4-column by 4-row grid of 16 equal square texture tiles, each tile exactly 256x256. No borders, gaps, labels, text, shadows cast across tiles, outlines around tiles, cube renderings, perspective, hexagon outlines, or background margins. Each tile looks like authentic hand-drawn 16x16 pixel art enlarged by nearest neighbor 16 times: crisp large square pixels, restrained 6–10 color ramps, chunky pixel clusters, NO blur, gradients, antialiasing, photographic detail or high resolution grain. Flat orthographic unlit albedo textures for mapping onto hexagonal voxel prism faces, in a cozy low resolution Minecraft-inspired space exploration game related to Tenebris. Fill every tile corner with opaque texture. Every texture should repeat as seamlessly as possible. Do not bake directional sunlight or ambient occlusion into the albedo. For row1 col2, show a horizontal ground-layer edge occupying upper quarter, soil below, tileable left-right. Biome: Temperate fields, planet Tenebris. Strong coherent palette: #334b36, #79904c, #c5bd77, #70513a. Dominant terrain golden olive pasture grass, substrate warm brown soil, stone gray limestone, accents white field flowers. Grid contents in strict reading order left to right top to bottom: 1. pasture grass; 2. grass over dirt side; 3. crumbly dirt; 4. limestone; 5. copper ore in limestone; 6. clay; 7. oak bark; 8. oak end grain; 9. oak leaves; 10. wildflower ground; 11. mossy limestone; 12. packed path; 13. pebbled earth; 14. cut oak boards; 15. tilled soil; 16. weathered ruins. Keep all sixteen materials clearly distinct and useful as actual tiled game textures.
